wallpapers.title: SELFIE WITH INGENUITY
wallpapers.line1: The Perseverance rover and the Ingenuity helicopter, 3.9 m (13 feet) away. Stitched from 62 photos.
wallpapers.line2: Perseverance, WATSON camera on its arm  ·  6 April 2021  ·  NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS

wallpapers.title: KOROLEV CRATER
wallpapers.line1: An 82 km wide crater in the far north of Mars, filled all year with ice about 1.8 km thick.
wallpapers.line2: Mars Express, HRSC camera  ·  published 20 December 2018  ·  ESA/DLR/FU Berlin, CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO

wallpapers.title: GREENHEUGH PEDIMENT
wallpapers.line1: Crusty sandstone in front, the floor of Gale crater (154 km wide) far behind. On the way up Mount Sharp.

wallpapers.title: THE DUNES OF NILI PATERA
wallpapers.line1: Sand dunes in one of the most active dune fields on Mars, seen from 271 km up. The wind keeps moving them.
wallpapers.line2: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter, HiRISE camera  ·  1 March 2014  ·  NASA/JPL-Caltech/Univ. of Arizona

wallpapers.title: MOUNT SHARP
wallpapers.line1: Morning light on Mount Sharp, the 5 km (3 mile) tall mountain Curiosity has been climbing since 2014.

wallpapers.title: THE BUTTERFLY CRATER
wallpapers.line1: An oval crater, 20 by 15 km, in true colour. Its shape suggests an impact at a shallow angle, 5 to 10 degrees.
wallpapers.line2: Mars Express, HRSC camera, about 350 km up  ·  8 November 2024  ·  ESA/DLR/FU Berlin, CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO

wallpapers.title: HUSBAND HILL
wallpapers.line1: Spirit's view up Husband Hill: the top is about 200 m away and 45 m higher. Close to true colour.

wallpapers.title: VALLES MARINERIS
wallpapers.line1: A canyon system over 3,000 km long and up to 8 km deep, from 102 Viking photos. Colours boosted about 2x.
